english.title: Member of Local Authority / council manager fail to disclose unpaid community charge
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being

(A)_[a member]_
(B)_[a council manager]_

to whom section 106(2) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 applied, you were present at a meeting when

(C)_[a calculation required by Chapter III, IV, 4ZA or IVA of Part I of]_
(D)_[a recommendation, resolution or other decision which might affect the making of a calculation required by Chapter III, IV, 4ZA or IVA of Part I of]_
(E)_[the exercise of a function under Schedules 2 to 4 to]_

the Local Government Finance Act 1992 was the subject of consideration and

(F)_[failed at the meeting and as soon as practicable after its commencement to disclose]_
(G)_[cast a vote on a question with respect to the matter under discussion without disclosing]_

the fact that a sum falling within paragraph 1(1)(a) of Schedule 4 to the Act had become payable by you and remained unpaid for at least two months
english.legislation: Contrary to section 106 of the Local Government Finance Act 1992.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
a member / council manager
to whom section 106(2) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 applied
was present during a meeting when
a calculation required by Chapter III, IV, 4ZA or IVA of Part I of the Act OR
a recommendation / resolution / other decision
which might affect the making of a calculation
required by Chapter III, IV, 4ZA or IVA of Part I of the Act OR
the exercise of a function under Sch's 2 to 4 to the Act
was being discussed AND
failed at the meeting and as soon as practicable
after its commencement to disclose OR
cast a vote on a question with respect to the matter under discussion
without disclosing that
a sum falling within para 1(1)(a) of Sch 4
of the Local Government Finance Act 1992
had become payable and remained unpaid for at least two months

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 106(3) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 provides a defence if the defendant proves that he did not know that this section applied to him at the time of the meeting; or that the matter in question was the subject of consideration at the meeting.
(ii) Section 106(4) of the Local Government Finance Act 1992 provides that a prosecution for an offence under this section shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of the Director of Public Prosecutions.
(iii) "Local authority" has the same meaning as in sections 94 and 97 of the Local Government Act 1972.
